dedupe_keys.name: centrifuge modelling of the cyclic response of ring anchors in shared configuration for floating offshore wind turbines

description: Centrifuge Modelling of the Cyclic Response of Ring Anchors in Shared Configuration for Floating Offshore Wind Turbines is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Alejandro Martinez, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). The deeply embedded ring anchor is a new anchorage system for floating offshore wind that can offer higher material efficiency compared to traditional anchors like monopiles and caissons. The ring anchor is also compatible with the shared anchor configuration, which can significantly reduce the quantity of required anchors for an offshore shore wind array. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Ring Anchor, Shared Anchor, Floating Offshore Wind, Centrifuge Modeling, Cyclic Loading. Published 2026-01-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
